title: The  race to build AGI: who's winning in 2026?

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: In 2026, who's closest to achieving AGI — and what does that mean for our world?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Large language models and neural architecture search are advancing fast, but AGI remains speculative.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: The rise of AGI could widen inequality and erode human agency if not governed responsibly.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Researchers are building alignment frameworks and using reinforcement learning from human feedback.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: With global collaboration, AGI could revolutionize healthcare and education by solving complex challenges.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The race to AGI isn’t just about speed — it’s about shaping a future we all can trust.

video_cue: A global network of AI research labs connected by glowing data streams, symbolizing collaboration and progress.
